# my-order-reports-lateness

Synthetic, "My order" (§6.4). The user drags Pulborough ahead of Portsmouth, whose window is
"before 10:00". Pulborough is done at 09:54; Portsmouth is then reached at about 11:21, 81 minutes
late. The plan keeps the user's order and reports the lateness on Portsmouth ("late by 81 min")
instead of reordering or dropping it.
